title: Vanishing coefficients outside a prescribed family
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\\mathcal F$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{\\pm1\\}$, and let $T\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$ with $T\\notin\\mathcal F$. For $a,x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n$, set $I_a(x)=\\prod_{i=1}^n(1+a_ix_i)/2$, and define $P_a(x)=\\sum_{S\\in\\mathcal F}\\widehat I_a(S)\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i$ and $K_a(x)=2^n|\\mathcal F|^{-1}P_a(x)$. The function $A_f(x)=\\sum_{a\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n}f(a)K_a(x)$ has Fourier coefficient zero at $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $\\mathcal F$ is a nonempty finite family of coordinate subsets
